g.text: 3 control-plane-only hosts • 5 workers • private node traffic over Tailscale
WireGuard-encrypted node, API, etcd and VXLAN traffic
each worker chooses a healthy controller
etcd uses :2379 / :2380. Controllers run no workload Pods. No external API VIP.
No kube-proxy. Egress uses eth0. Never advertise Pod or Service CIDRs to Tailscale.
Recovery: tailscale-k0s kubeconfig → controller :6443 over Tailscale
Uses an admin client certificate; bypasses the in-cluster API proxy.
